model_claims.text: The function will reject decode-content switches before consuming any body data.
model_claims.source_quote: Reject decode-mode switches in read_chunked before consuming body data.

model_claims.text: In the base implementation, illegal decode_content switches were rejected only after advancing chunk state, inside _decode().
model_claims.source_quote: `HTTPResponse.read_chunked()` rejected illegal `decode_content=True` → `False` switches only inside `_decode()`, after already advancing chunk state.

model_claims.text: The PR mirrors the fix in read(): it resolves decode_content first and raises RuntimeError before updating chunk length or handling the chunk.
After the RuntimeError is raised, the chunk_left counter, mock buffer, and index remain unchanged (as asserted by the strengthened regression test).
model_claims.source_quote: Strengthen the regression test to assert `chunk_left` / mock buffer / index are unchanged after the raise.

model_claims.text: The new ordering in read_chunked() is: resolve decode_content, if amt != 0 and decode_content is False and decoded content was already consumed raise immediately, then enter the chunk read loop.
model_claims.source_quote: This change applies the same ordering to `read_chunked()`: 1. Resolve `decode_content is None` to `self.decode_content` 2. If `amt != 0` and `decode_content is False` and decoded content was already consumed, raise immediately 3. Only then enter the chunk read loop
